glosses.notes: Usually refers to the whole world or something worldwide.

examples.sentence: 这条新闻很快传到全球。
全球很多地方都在下雨。
现在全球都在学中文。

example_translations.translation: This news quickly spread around the world.
It is raining in many places around the world.
People around the world are studying Chinese now.

glosses.notes: Refers to the entire body, often in health or physical-state contexts.

examples.sentence: 他跑完以后全身都是汗。
医生说她全身都没问题。
天太热了，她全身都是汗。

example_translations.translation: After he finished running, his whole body was covered in sweat.
The doctor said there was no problem anywhere in her body.
It was so hot that her whole body was covered in sweat.

glosses.primary_gloss: to lack; to be short of
glosses.notes: Often means to be short of something or to have something missing.

examples.sentence: 我们队今天缺一个人。
这张桌子缺一条腿。
他什么都不缺，只缺时间。

example_translations.translation: Our team is missing one person today.
This table is missing one leg.
He lacks nothing except time.

glosses.notes: A common word for a person's weakness or the drawback of a thing or method.

examples.sentence: 这个办法的缺点是太慢。
每个人都有自己的缺点。
她的缺点就是太着急。

example_translations.translation: The drawback of this method is that it is too slow.
Everyone has their own shortcomings.
Her weakness is that she gets anxious too easily.

glosses.primary_gloss: to lack; to be short of
glosses.notes: Often used for not having enough of something needed.

examples.sentence: 这个地方缺少水。
这篇文章缺少例子。
我们现在最缺少的是时间。

example_translations.translation: This place is short of water.
This article lacks examples.
What we lack most right now is time.

glosses.notes: Used to show contrast, often with an unexpected result.

examples.sentence: 我想早点睡，却一点也不困。
他看见我了，却没有说话。
这件衣服不贵，却很好看。

example_translations.translation: I want to go to bed early, but I am not sleepy at all.
He saw me, yet he did not say anything.
This piece of clothing is not expensive, but it looks very nice.

glosses.notes: Used to stress that something is true or real.

examples.sentence: 这家店的菜确实不错。
他今天确实来过。
这个办法确实有用。

example_translations.translation: The dishes at this restaurant really are good.
He really did come today.
This method is indeed useful.

glosses.notes: A formal but common way to connect two contrasting ideas.

examples.sentence: 他很想去，然而今天没有时间。
这条路不远，然而不好走。
我们准备好了，然而飞机晚点了。

example_translations.translation: He really wants to go; however, he has no time today.
This road is not far; however, it is not easy to walk on.
We were ready, but the plane was delayed.

glosses.notes: Usually describes a place or situation with lots of people, noise, and activity.

examples.sentence: 晚上这条街很热闹。
商场里人很多，非常热闹。
大家一来，家里就热闹起来了。

example_translations.translation: This street is lively at night.
There are many people in the mall, so it feels very bustling.
As soon as everyone arrived, the home came alive.

glosses.notes: Refers to a person's life as a whole, often in everyday reflections.

examples.sentence: 他常说，人生要有目标。
人生不只有工作，也要有休息。
这本书写的是一位老师的人生。

example_translations.translation: He often says that life should have goals.
Life is not only about work; it also needs rest.
This book is about a teacher's life.

glosses.notes: Used for how many people are in a group, place, or activity.

examples.sentence: 今天来开会的人数不多。
我们先看看报名人数。
今天参加活动的人数比昨天多。

example_translations.translation: The number of people coming to the meeting today is not large.
Let us first check the signup headcount.
More people took part in the activity today than yesterday.

glosses.notes: A general word for staff, workers, or other personnel in an organization or place.

examples.sentence: 公司人员已经到齐了。
商店的服务人员很热情。
学校安排了专门的安全人员。

example_translations.translation: All the company staff have arrived.
The service staff in the shop are very warm and friendly.
The school arranged dedicated safety staff.

glosses.notes: Used before a noun to mean any person, thing, or kind without limit.

examples.sentence: 你有任何问题都可以问我。
这里不欢迎任何广告。
他没对任何人说这件事。

example_translations.translation: If you have any questions, you can ask me.
Advertising of any kind is not welcome here.
He did not tell anyone about this matter.

glosses.notes: A piece of work that someone has to do.

examples.sentence: 我今天的任务是整理文件。
这个任务比我想的难。
老师把任务分给了大家。

example_translations.translation: My task today is to organize the files.
This assignment is harder than I expected.
The teacher divided the task among everyone.

glosses.notes: Used for throwing something or tossing something away.

examples.sentence: 别把纸扔在地上。
他一生气就把杯子扔了。
这些旧东西别扔，我还要用。

example_translations.translation: Do not throw paper on the ground.
As soon as he got angry, he threw the cup.
Do not throw these old things away; I still need them.

glosses.notes: A written-style word meaning still, often showing that a situation has not changed.

examples.sentence: 雨下得很大，他仍要出门。
过了这么久，她仍记得那天。
大家都下班了，他仍在办公室。

example_translations.translation: It was raining heavily, but he still wanted to go out.
Even after so long, she still remembers that day.
Everyone else is off work, yet he is still in the office.

glosses.notes: Means still or even now, often in everyday statements about something unchanged.

examples.sentence: 这么晚了，楼下仍然很热闹。
他换了工作以后，仍然住在这里。
老师讲了三次，他仍然没听懂。

example_translations.translation: It is already so late, but downstairs is still lively.
After changing jobs, he still lives here.
The teacher explained it three times, and he still did not understand.

glosses.notes: Describes things that belong to ordinary daily life or routine.

examples.sentence: 这些都是我的日常工作。
她喜欢把日常生活写进日记。
运动已经成了他的日常习惯。

example_translations.translation: These are all part of my daily work.
She likes to write her everyday life into her diary.
Exercise has already become part of his daily routine.

glosses.notes: A notebook or record where someone writes about daily life and thoughts.

examples.sentence: 她每天晚上都写日记。
这本日记是高中时写的。
我在日记里记下了那次旅行。

example_translations.translation: She writes in her diary every night.
This diary was written in high school.
I wrote that trip down in my journal.

glosses.notes: The written or stated calendar date of an event or document.

examples.sentence: 请在这里写上日期。
我忘了会议的日期。
她先看了看机票上的日期。

example_translations.translation: Please write the date here.
I forgot the date of the meeting.
She first checked the date on the plane ticket.

glosses.notes: Can mean a day or period of time, and also everyday life or how life is going.

examples.sentence: 下雨的日子，他不想出门。
以前的日子不好过。
搬到这里以后，我们的日子安静多了。

example_translations.translation: On rainy days, he does not want to go out.
Life was not easy in the past.
After moving here, our life became much quieter.

glosses.notes: A common written-style word for entering, often seen in set patterns and compounds.

examples.sentence: 他刚入门，就看见老师了。
天一入夜，路上就没什么人了。
球一入网，大家都站起来了。

example_translations.translation: As soon as he entered, he saw the teacher.
As soon as night fell, there were hardly any people on the road.
As soon as the ball went into the net, everyone stood up.

glosses.notes: The place where people go in.

examples.sentence: 图书馆入口在左边。
请不要站在入口拍照。
医院入口有很多人。

example_translations.translation: The library entrance is on the left.
Please do not stand at the entrance to take pictures.
There are many people at the hospital entrance.

glosses.notes: Used for beginning school or officially enrolling in a school.

examples.sentence: 孩子六岁就可以入学。
她九月正式入学。
入学以前，他一直跟爷爷住。

example_translations.translation: Children can start school at age six.
She will officially enroll in September.
Before entering school, he had always lived with his grandfather.

glosses.primary_gloss: to check in; to move in
glosses.notes: Used for checking into a hotel or moving into a new place to live.

examples.sentence: 我们下午三点以后才能入住。
新房子下周可以入住了。
客人刚刚办理了入住。

example_translations.translation: We can only check in after three in the afternoon.
The new house will be ready to move into next week.
The guest just completed check-in.
